title: Bad payment model
body:
Subscription model or one time fee- but you get ads and only one entry on the free version? Yikes. If there are going to be ads, open up the full version for free.  
As for the app, I had to sit through a 30 second ad when I went to add a habit that didn’t even save. 
Too bad; could have been what I was looking for but the paywall with ads really put me off.
author: kkudzu
